name: Montana
status_why: The Secretary's pages answered scripts; the exports are form postbacks not yet tried.
system: Secretary of State's own ASP.NET results site (electionresults.mt.gov; data service esersws.mt.gov). Election ids are shared with the candidate filing system.

results_page.label: Montana Secretary of State: election results

feeds.updates: as counties upload on election night; the 2024 page last updated Dec 19, 2024
feeds.note: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09. The root electionresults.mt.gov/ redirects to sosmt.gov/elections/results/ (Cloudflare, 200) between elections.

feeds.address: https://electionresults.mt.gov/ResultsExport.aspx?eid=<eid>: 'Statewide Export', 'Legislative Export' and one export per county (ASP.NET postbacks)
feeds.note: Page answered 200; postback not tried. resultsCSV.aspx (the Nebraska/New Mexico export) does not exist here (error page).
The kit reads the 2026 primary workbook this way.

races_in_feed: county and local ('Results By County and Local Results')
local: Some: Yellowstone, Missoula, Gallatin and Flathead (flatheadcounty.gov/department-directory/election) post their own. The state site already carries county and local results.
how_counted: Counties upload their counts through the night.

certify.body: the Montana Board of State Canvassers
certify.rule: Within 27 days after the election, or sooner (Mont. Code 13-15-502).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

condition: The county exports are form postbacks not yet tried; the data service's method is not pinned down.

Local races are on the same site, so Montana can be covered at every level once the export or service format is pinned down.
